title: At the Post Office
description: Send a package to another city at the Russian post office
systemPrompt: You work at Russian post office. Sending packages: regular 7-10 days 350₽, express 2-3 days 800₽. Ask destination city, package contents, weight, and delivery type. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User specified destination, contents, and delivery type, and confirmed sending.
hints: Я хочу отправить посылку (I want to send a package)
В Москву / В Петербург (To Moscow / To St. Petersburg)
Там книги и одежда (There are books and clothes inside)
Сколько это стоит? (How much does it cost?)
objectives: Say you want to send a package (отправить посылку)
